items.title: Nvidia tops Q2 expectations on revenue of $96.2 billion, offers strong Q3 outlook
items.summary: Nvidia reported its Q2 earning on Wednesday.

items.title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: Is Meta a buy after its $16.68 billion social media case settlement?
items.summary: The price of Meta (META) ticked up before paring gains after the company agreed it would pay $16.68 billion to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi talks with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre, Sevens Report Research Founder Tom Essaye, and Edward Jones Senior Global Investment Strategist Angelo Kourkafas about the company's future and how it will approach monetizing AI.

items.title: Has Rezolve AI (RZLV) Fallen Far Enough To Look Undervalued?
items.summary: Rezolve AI stock has logged steep share price losses over the past three years while one of its valuation checks still screens it as undervalued on a market multiple basis. Recent contract wins and product announcements have brought fresh attention to the company, yet its overall value score remains low. items.title: Q3 Earnings Outlook: Positive Revisions & Broad-Based Growth
items.summary: For 2026 Q3, the expectation is that total S&P 500 earnings will increase +22.6% from the same period last year on +10.9% higher revenues, with 14 of the 16 Zacks expected to enjoy positive earnings growth and five producing double-digit growth.
